sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-a-run-whose-r.purpose: A Running and a WaitingOnDecision run whose runtime is gone end as orphaned; the end withdraws the waiting run's Open request itself.

sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-a-submit-with.purpose: A submit that names no confinement is taken: the handler fills the daemon's default level and the run is Submitted. A submit that names a level below the floor is still refused.

sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-an-answer-is-.purpose: An answer is judged by its request before its run: already-answered whatever the run does, withdrawn after a cancel (the cancel withdraws the request).

sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-answer-to-an-.purpose: A second answer to a request that is already answered is refused and the first answer stands; an answer naming another run is refused.

sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-cancel-a-run.purpose: A waiting run is cancelled; the same step withdraws its Open request, so a WithdrawDecision finds it not open and an answer to it is refused as withdrawn; a second cancel and a late event are refused.

sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-closed-sessio.purpose: A closed session takes no new run and keeps the run it has; a run into a session that does not exist is refused; a session name is taken once.

sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-context-outsi.purpose: A context outside every context root is refused; an unknown runbook is refused; a context under a root is taken.

sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-decision-is-a.purpose: A run stops on a decision and waits; the runtime raises the request; the run cannot resume while it is open; a client answers it; the run resumes and ends.

sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-events-after-.purpose: The events page after a position holds only the events with a larger position; the runtime records from sequence 2, after the submit event.

sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-idempotent-su.purpose: A second submit with a used idempotency key creates no run and answers the first; other keys and no key each create a run.

sdc.daemon/authored/daemon-two-runs-in-a.purpose: Two runs of one session keep their own sequence numbers (from 2, after the submit event); the session page shows both in position order.
